LanguageData.LP_KelemvorChurch.label: doomguard of Kelemvor
LanguageData.LP_KelemvorChurch.description: Doomguards sent by the church of Kelemvor, god of death: grey robes and longswords, hunting undead that should not exist. They negotiate with no one.
LanguageData.LP_KelemvorChurch.ideoDescription: Death is just, and those who flee it must be brought back.
